name: Seraph Horizons
description: The Seraph Horizons modpack's own mod. It holds the pack's tweaks, each one switchable in ModConfig/seraphhorizons.json: gameplay tweaks to other mods; Tidy Variants, which hides orientation and open/closed variants and groups the remaining variants of each block or item into one creative tile and one handbook page (right-click a tile to expand its group); /revealmap, which shows terrain already generated (e.g. by /wgen pregen) on your world map without going there; and creative mod tabs, a button that switches the creative inventory to one tab per mod.
